Pin map: the XC7A200T FGG676 package ball by ball, with an XDC lint

All 676 balls of the XC7A200T FGG676 by bank and type, with our board's pins on top. Paste or drop an XDC: it is linted in your browser and sent nowhere.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

  • gHashTag/t27 fpga/HARDWARE_SSOT.md at 8fcafe894, 2026-07-05 update: xc7a200tfbg676-1 and xc7a200tfgg676-1 share the die and the BGA-676 pinout
